answer: Each identity tends one karst spring watering a meadow plot below one ledge, cementing a 60 POA gauge into its spring, a one-time purchase never moved, resold, or shared. Each epoch a census verifier pings every gauge at once; each identity must answer with a fresh flow reading from its own spring. A fake echoing a neighbor's reading or claiming a spring already gauged is caught at once: gauge smashed, license revoked 6 epochs, 60 POA gone. Ten clones need ten gauges, 600 POA sunk, yet one operator cannot answer ten simultaneous pings, so nine gauges are smashed and 540 POA is lost.
